evidence.description:
Walter Canada breaks down the government programs, policy changes, and financial 
rules that affect everyday Canadians — especially seniors. CPP, Old Age Security, 
health coverage, benefits, your rights, your money. All of it, explained in plain 
English the way it should have been from the start.

🎯 What you'll find here:
✅ New laws and policy changes explained in plain English
✅ Step-by-step guides to claiming the benefits you're owed (CPP, OAS, GIS & more)
✅ How to protect your money and know your rights
✅ Straight answers — no filler, no agenda

Hit subscribe and turn on notifications so you never miss what matters. 🔔

⚠️ Walter Canada is an independent educational channel and is not affiliated with 
the Government of Canada, Service Canada, or the CRA. Always confirm details with 
official sources.
